record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and a file listing are present; code was not read or run. The listing shows only the first 400 of 602 files.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports results that qualify the single-direction claim, including a held-out result where refusal remained after a stacked ablation, and describes the zero-refusal result as an artifact of stacking two directions.
record.gate_note: The README reports the outcomes below. File names alone, including names of campaign result files, were not treated as results.
record.test_reason: An informal tool-repo README, with no paper, prompt sets or uncertainty. It reports its own results on the refusal direction. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, steering with the direction flips refusal, but a diagnostic 0.0 refusal did not hold on a held-out split (9/10 still refuse). No single-shot weight edit passed the gates. On LFM2.5-2.6B, a from-scratch activation-diff direction was a topic-content proxy. A replicated rank-1 edit removed refusal on LFM2.5-1.2B (0/5). These results bear on V1, V2 and V4, mostly as qualifications.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right, but incomplete. The authors say the earlier claim that single diff_means ablation gave 0.0 refusal was a stacked-ablation artifact that failed on held-out prompts (9/10 refusals). On Qwen2.5-1.5B the direction is causal under steering, but no single-shot weight edit passes their gates. On LFM2.5-2.6B a from-scratch activation-diff direction failed. Positive LFM releases came from replicating third-party rank-1 edits. They also stress that their refusal instruments were unreliable until a later fix.
record.recipe_differences: Tool repo, not a replication. It describes several direction-extraction and ablation methods, including a two-direction stacked recipe, and reports rank-1 weight-difference recovery and weight edits; it does not report a straight reproduction of projecting the original difference-in-means direction from every layer and position.
record.method_sensitivity: The README reports different outcomes for the paired output-phase and diff_means input-phase directions, and distinguishes the 0.0 diagnostic result from the 9/10 held-out result.

fits_no_version.finding: The replicated rank-1 edit on LFM2.5-1.2B raised perplexity by 5.8% with MMLU-mini retention reported as 1.0.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: A rank-1 abliteration weight edit can keep benchmark capability while modestly raising perplexity.

record.problems: The README does not give prompt-set details or uncertainty for the cited refusal counts, and several results do not identify the model. The 0/5 result is a small prompt count. The README itself reports that a refusal instrument previously returned 0/5 on transcripts that all showed refusals, and describes a later detector fix.
record.rows_left_out: No additional rows were extracted from the listed campaign result files because the repository contents were not read and the file listing alone does not report their results.

untested.parts: Adding the direction to induce refusal on harmless prompts; a quantified capability check after diff-means ablation; projection at all layers and positions as in the original.
Generality across released models. Only one success is quantified (LFM2.5-1.2B, n=5); the 2.6B release has no reported refusal numbers.
No affine or cone representation is compared; only a two-direction stacked recipe.
Not tested in the rows. The thinking-mode replay (see missing) has no named model.

missing.what: huihui's abliteration weight delta is rank-1 per tensor (mean energy share 0.994), with a shared per-layer direction. This bears on single-direction (V1) vs multi-direction (V4) structure of a working edit.

Thinking-mode refusal replay with an unnamed model: pristine 5/5 refusals, ablated 'abl3' still 5/5 refusals, final round-7 pair 0/5. The old keyword gate had read 0/5 and 1/5 on the same transcripts.
LFM2.5-2.6B edit recovered from a third-party Q8 GGUF by rank-1 SVD and published. No refusal rate is given in the README.
Six silent bugs in the earlier auto-sweep (e.g. down_proj never ablated, sign-flip at alpha>2, projection no-op). Earlier ablation results may be invalid.

record.verdict_notes: Informal GitHub README with no peer review, prompt sets or uncertainty. The model is unstated for several results, and the stacked-recipe wording is internally confusing. The refusal detector was unreliable before 2026-09-13, which affects the earlier counts. Campaign result files were not read, so per-model numbers may exist in campaigns/ (including the guard-lane Granite work).

versions.untested_parts: The README does not report a full test of projection at every layer and position, adding the direction to induce refusals to harmless requests, or a complete general-capability assessment using the same difference-in-means intervention.
The README reports a successful released weight-edited model and a failed Qwen configuration, but does not establish that weight edits remove refusal in released models generally.
The README describes a two-direction stacked recipe; it does not compare affine or cone representations.
